snippet.title: BAMDMI Debute - Demo Showcase
snippet.description: Hayo! I'm MinoModding, and it's my first fully playable game. I was inspired by wonderful games BABBDI and VOIMA - their soul, atmosphere and sense of presence made me create this game. This game is building sandbox, where you don't limited with grid. You can extract peaces out of world and build everything with it. It makes you going to find secrets of this place, even though you're not sure if they exist. And i'll say - they're exist. You can play game in ~2026-2027, cause there's so much to do. Also, you can tell your ideas for game, and your idea have a chance to be in game. Remember about atmosphere, because of it i don't gonna add some laughy stuff, if it's not fits in game. Enjoy with first showcase :)
